versions.changelog:
Initial release of the socks-designer skill.

- Generate custom socks designs for print-on-demand (POD) and manufacturing-on-demand (MOD).
- Supports text/image prompts, structured parameters, and reference images for customizations such as material, fit, and prints.
- Enables placement of custom text and logos, generation of multi-view images, and use of interactive 3D viewers.
- API allows creation of socks and other clothing draft designs with easy integration of manufacturing workflows.
- Requires a OneKey Gateway access key for full feature access.
